hero.title: Master English listening, one sentence at a time
hero.subtitle: Dictation practice following the Cambridge English Prepare path — from Pre-A1 to B2 First.

levels.title: Your learning path
levels.subtitle: Follow the books in order, or jump to the level that fits you.

method.title: The 4-step method
method.subtitle: Every lesson follows the same rhythm — hear it, write it, fix it, say it.

step1.title: Listen
step1.desc: Play the audio as many times as you need — slow it down if you want.

step2.title: Type
step2.desc: Write exactly what you hear, word by word.

step3.title: Check
step3.desc: See every mistake word by word and fix your sentence.

step4.title: Read aloud
step4.desc: Say the correct sentence out loud to lock it in.
